title: Elite: Swear the Betrayal Memory Hollow: Antechamber Seal
description: Elite: Swear the Betrayal Memory Hollow: Antechamber Seal is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). One selected deity from Odin, Freyja, Frigg, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Odin as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the pre boss step at Betrayal Memory Hollow, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Betrayal Memory Hollow and reveals: Why world-roots remember betrayals. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.

objectives.primary: With one selected deity, survive the boss approach in the elite-tuned Betrayal Memory Hollow, secure the boss approach, and enter the chamber with the route law understood.
optional: Clear the Betrayal Memory Hollow without the active deity falling below 35% integrity
Exploit or avoid the route rule: lightning that strikes cowardice before armor
Resolve at least three oath law, storm timing, world-root control, courage under blackwinter pressure decisions before victory
Finish with the boss, elite, shrine, treasure, or hazard node clearly readable for mobile tactical play
Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

boss.notes: Boss pressure tied to banner command and broken-oath memory.
